title: Chicago Bears legend Matt Suhey, best friend of late Walter Payton, dies at 68

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chicago Bears legend Matt Suhey, best friend of late Walter Payton, dies at 68
sources.description: Matt Suhey was a second-round pick who spent his entire 10-year NFL career in Chicago, mostly leading his Hall of Fame backfield mate to glory.
